name: Starcloud
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
description: Starcloud is privately held and has no ticker. Review the price of each funding round, the investors and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Starcloud is a privately held space technology company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $250 million Series A extension announced on August 21, 2026, valued the company at $2.3 billion.

Founded in 2024 as Lumen Orbit and based in Redmond, Washington, Starcloud builds satellites that carry data center computing hardware, with the aim of running AI workloads in orbit on solar power. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.

table_note: Valuations are as reported at the time of each round. The seed round valuation is as reported by TechCrunch.
round_notes: Manhattan West led the Series A extension, which followed the original Series A by five months. Via Satellite reported that the extension brought Starcloud's total funding to $450 million, a figure that also includes earlier financings not shown in the table.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Manhattan West led the Series A extension, with participation from Nvidia, Cisco Investments, Benchmark, EQT and NFX. Benchmark and EQT Ventures led the Series A, and NFX led the 2024 seed round. Other investors include Y Combinator, Soma Capital, 776 and FUSE.
spv_sentence: SEC filings show 14 special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Starcloud, all of them first filed in 2026.
sources: Sources: Starcloud's Series A announcement (March 30, 2026); TechCrunch reports dated August 21, 2026, March 30, 2026, December 11, 2024 and October 24, 2024; a Via Satellite report (August 21, 2026); and SEC Form D filings.
